name: Left 4 Blox 2
desc:
SERVER RESTART = UPDATE

This game is still in early alpha, meaning that it's very jank right now! It is also a sandbox where you can only play as survivors and some special infected right now.
Remember to report bugs to me if you find them.
This game supports PC, console* and mobile*.
*Console does not have full support and lacks the ability to use the Options menu.
*Mobile has full support, however, a high resolution mobile phone or tablet is recommended as some GUIs may not fit for low-resolution screens.

Roadmap:
- Common Infected
- All weapons from L4D2
- A ton of other things

Based off of Left 4 Dead 2 and inspired by Left 2 Die by Fuze Studios
